coverage.category: 35. Employers of foreign workers (work permits, quota, forecast)
coverage.found: Work permit required before an employment contract (Migration Code); annual quota set by the Cabinet; employers submit a forecast (older sources: by 1 May); passport retention banned; State Migration Service control and employer liability. A 30 Oct 2025 Cabinet decision 323 lists the information systems integrated into a 'Highly Qualified Migrant' portal (fetched; only the State Tax Service system listed). Current forecast dates unverified.

coverage.category: 36. Food importers (AQTA import notification and approval)
coverage.found: See cat. 30. Candidate listed.

coverage.category: 37. Gas installation maintenance contractors under the new Gas Supply Law
coverage.found: The amended law introduces 'specialized contractor' (technical maintenance by an attested legal entity or person) and a registry of inspection and maintenance data (per a search summary; the text was not read). Cabinet decision 36 of 2023 on gas installations is cancelled by a 2026 decision (title only). Unverified.
